usageNotes: Use this to update the filter rules, layout, or include-all flag of an existing PDM view. The caller must hold Resource.Modify on the view's ACL path. Pass `digest` (obtained from a prior GET) to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other — omit it only in non-contested automation.

examples.summary: Narrow a view to only include specific cluster nodes and persist a saved layout

tips: Use the `delete` array to remove individual properties (e.g., `"delete": ["exclude"]`) rather than overwriting them with empty values.
The `layout` field is an opaque JSON string as stored by the PDM UI — capture it from a GET response to avoid format mismatches.
Setting `include-all: true` makes `include` rules additive exceptions rather than the sole whitelist; combine with `exclude` to blacklist noisy resource types.
View names are immutable after creation; to rename, create a new view and delete the old one.
